workerAccess.description: Named worker allowed across tenants for this entity, only through the dedicated worker database identity.

schemaVersion.description: The only authored shape: behaviour in operations and interfaces, relationships on fields.

pluralLabels.description: Plural form of labels; carried by derived inverse collections. Absent: the English label is pluralised and other locales keep their singular.

domains.description: Optional domain tags used to group entities independently from contexts or profiles.

displayTemplate.description: Canonical human-readable template for an instance, e.g. '{{title}}' or '{{street}} {{houseNumber}}'. Placeholders reference entity field keys.

filterField.description: Field key used when filtering a list of this entity by free-text input (typeahead in pickers). Wires into generated FilterInput with ilike semantics.

indexes.description: Storage-level indexes, compiled into TableDefinition.indexes and emitted as CREATE [UNIQUE] INDEX IF NOT EXISTS. Declare one only when it backs a runtime contract the engine relies on — e.g. the tenant-scoped uniqueness an idempotent `ON CONFLICT (...) DO NOTHING` insert needs.

fields.description: Authored field definitions use the canonical recursive FieldDefinition contract (`osfType`, not the superseded `type`).

authorization.description: Entity-level RBAC authorization. Defines roles required for CRUD operations. Used by the compiler to generate GraphQL auth guards and Keycloak role definitions.

ownerAxis.description: Owner-axis read policy for an entity owned through more than one reference (one table, several owners). Each listed reference lends its owner entity's `authorization.roles.read` to the rows it owns, and the compiler emits a RESTRICTIVE select policy so a session holding none of an owner's read roles never sees that owner's rows, whatever the entity's own read roles say. `command` names a transaction-local setting and the values a server-side command marks its transaction with to read every owner's rows (a template publisher re-seeding the documents that track the template).

fields.description: Owning reference fields of this entity (each `relationship.inverse.ownership: owned`). The target entity's read roles gate the rows that reference carries.

setting.description: Transaction-local setting the command sets (set_config(..., true)).

rowAccess.description: Row-level access filtering. When enabled, the compiler emits a Postgres RLS policy (`FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY`) alongside the tenant predicate. Add an `owner` axis to make each row visible only to the user recorded in its owner column, and/or a `group` axis to make each row visible only within the org-unit hierarchy recorded in its group column; without any axis the policy is plain tenant scoping. Owner and group axes are independently combinable (both emit OR-branches). The platform-admin bypass (app.bypass_rls()) and tenant scope (app.has_scope('tenant')) always short-circuit the policy.

enabled.description: Enable row-level access filtering for this entity.

empty.description: Behavior when a row's group/owner column IS NULL: 'public' = the NULL-column row is visible tenant-wide (OR-NULL branch emitted); 'restricted' = NULL-column rows are hidden. Defaults to 'public'. Forced to 'restricted' when 'owner' is set. 'restricted' requires an owner or group axis — otherwise there is no confidentiality column to be NULL and the compiler fails closed.

owner.description: Owner-predicated axis. When set, the generated policy adds `"<column>" = app.current_user_id()`. Use for per-user data (preferences, notifications, drafts) where each user only sees rows they own. The column must be a uuid field or belongsTo foreignKey on this entity.

column.description: Persisted uuid column (or belongsTo foreignKey) on this entity that holds the owner's user id. Must reference a uuid-typed field or relationship foreignKey.

session.description: Session identity the owner column is compared against. Only 'app.current_user_id' is accepted — the runtime exposes just the current user id GUC. Per-account session vars are not supported.

group.description: Group-predicated mode. The generated RLS policy adds `"<column>" = ANY(<groups-fn>())` where the function is selected by `expand` (descendants→app.current_groups(), exact→app.current_groups_exact(), ancestors→app.current_groups_ancestors()). Use for org-unit / team confidentiality. The column must be a uuid field or belongsTo foreignKey holding the row's owning org-unit id.

column.description: Persisted uuid column (or belongsTo foreignKey) on this entity holding the owning org-unit id.

expand.description: How the user's directly-bound org units expand against the closure at session setup: descendants=see rows of child units, ancestors=see parents', exact=only direct units. Resolved into the per-mode GUC set before the query; the policy compares to the already-expanded set.

recordPermissions.description: Action-specific record authorization stored in one persisted JSON object. The object has fixed view/edit/delete members containing users/groups/roles arrays. RBAC remains mandatory; this ACL only narrows it.

field.description: Authored key of a required, persisted, single object field holding the record ACL.

empty.description: Meaning of a valid subject set whose users/groups/roles arrays are all empty. Malformed ACL data always fails closed.

createRequires.description: Record permissions the creator must hold in the submitted ACL before insert.

oneOf.description: A capability grant: core resolves a hashed, expiring, recipient-bound token into a grant session that names the covered Operations and the one record. REST only; tenancy must be required.
A control-realm operator: the bearer is verified against the platform's control realm (not a tenant realm) and must hold one of the listed realm roles. No tenant context exists; tenancy must be none.

roles.description: Optional operation-role allow-list. Omit for any authenticated session; an explicit empty list denies every role.

roleGroups.description: Conjunctive role gates. The session must hold at least one role from every non-empty group.

recordPermission.description: Required permission on the current record target, in addition to roles and scopes.

tools.description: Technical MCP tool projection. Dedicated emits one tool per projected operation; generic routes through the five shared osf_* CRUD tools.

description.en: A template over the record's fields, such as {{displayName}}.
description.nl: Een sjabloon over de velden van het record, zoals {{displayName}}.

description.en: The component that draws this field here, instead of the field's default.
description.nl: Het component dat dit veld hier tekent, in plaats van de standaard van het veld.

name.description: Persisted verbatim as the SQL index name, so it must be unique per entity and snake_case (e.g. billing_run_items_tenant_idempotency_uidx).

fields.description: Entity field keys (camelCase), resolved to persisted column names by the compiler. Put `tenantId` first for tenant-scoped uniqueness so the constraint is naturally tenant-isolated.

unique.description: Emits CREATE UNIQUE INDEX instead of CREATE INDEX.

where.description: Makes the index partial: only rows whose field equals the value (`{ field: isDefault, equals: true }`) or holds one at all (`{ field: invoiceNumber, present: true }`) take part, so a unique index enforces at most one such row per key.

graphqlType.description: Override the emitted GraphQL type for a non-persisted field. Pairs with a runtime resolver (e.g. ctx.labelService) that returns a value of this type.

render.description: Override the default UI component for this field. If omitted, the component catalog default for the field type is used.

component.description: Component name from the component catalog.

props.description: Props to pass to the component.

authorization.description: Field-level RBAC authorization. Defines roles required to read or mutate this field.

relationship.description: A compiled relationship (model.relationships of a compiled contract). Relationships are never authored at the entity level: a single reference is a field with an entity osfType and its inverse collection is derived.
